items.description:
Developed skills in web development using React and C#, as well as experience with AI and Ollama.

Internship: Working as a web developer, responsible for the development, deployment, and maintenance of websites.

Studied robotics, embedded systems and artificial intelligence. For my master's thesis, I developed a radar-based hand gesture recognition system using Python, TensorFlow, and convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The system achieved 95% classification accuracy with a prediction time of approximately 25 ms.
items.thesis: Implementation of Machine Learning Algorithm for Radar-Based Hand Gesture Recognition
